h: Cardigan Bay Days to Pair It With
p: Llanrhystud sits on a quiet stretch of Ceredigion coast, and that makes Fantasy Farm Park a handy stop whether you're staying near Aberystwyth or further down towards New Quay. The village has its own pebbly beach, where the River Wyre meets the sea, and it's a peaceful spot for a stroll, a paddle or skimming stones after a day with the animals.

Cardigan Bay is famous for its bottlenose dolphins, and New Quay is one of the best places to spot them, either from the harbour wall or on one of the boat trips that run in the warmer months. It's a magical experience for children and adults alike, though sightings are never guaranteed.

Llanerchaeron, a National Trust estate near Aberaeron, is a lovely combination of Georgian villa, working farm and walled gardens, and it gives kids another chance to meet farm animals in a historic setting. The Ceredigion Coast Path runs right along this coastline too, so you can pick a short stretch for a family walk with sea views.

For your visit to the farm park, pack snacks, wipes and a change of clothes, and let the kids set the pace. Farm days out are best enjoyed slowly, with time to stop and watch the animals rather than rushing from one pen to the next. Little ones often want to go round twice, so allow a bit of extra time. Aberaeron, with its brightly painted harbourside houses, is a lovely place to finish with an ice cream on the way home if you're heading south.
